import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for the post components. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{post_heading}

{content}
{labels}
""" def render_blog_post(author_id: str, post_heading: str, content: str, labels: list[str]) -> str: """ Generate a secure HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author_id : str Identifier of the post's creator. post_heading : str The heading/title of the post. content : str Main body text of the post. labels : list[str] Tags/labels associated with the post. Returns ------- str XSS‑protected HTML string for the post. """ # Escape all user supplied data to prevent XSS attacks. safe_author_id = html.escape(author_id, quote=True) safe_heading = html.escape(post_heading, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content) # Render each label inside a and escape its content. safe_labels = [] for lbl in labels: escaped_lbl = html.escape(lbl) safe_labels.append(f'{escaped_lbl}') labels_html = " ".join(safe_labels) # Fill the template with sanitized values. return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_id=safe_author_id, post_heading=safe_heading, content=safe_content, labels=labels_html )
